conversation.content: Compose a resignation letter as if you are Zuckerberg.

message.content:
**Mark Zuckerberg**  
Chief Executive Officer  
Meta Platforms, Inc.  
1 Hacker Way  
Menlo Park, CA 94025  

[Date]  

Dear Meta Board of Directors and Fellow Meta Employees,  

It is with a heavy heart and profound reflection that I write to you today to announce my resignation as Chief Executive Officer of Meta Platforms, Inc., effective immediately. After 20 years of building what started as a dorm-room project into one of the world's most influential technology companies, I believe it is time for new leadership to guide us into the next era.  

Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and our broader family of apps have connected billions of people, fostering communities, sparking movements, and driving unprecedented innovation in social technology. From launching the platform that powered the Arab Spring to pioneering AI through our Llama models and advancing the metaverse vision with Quest, we've pushed boundaries and reshaped how humanity interacts. Our Reality Labs division continues to bet big on the future of immersive computing, and Threads has shown remarkable momentum in challenging established networks. These achievements are a testament to the brilliance and dedication of every Meta employee.  

However, recent challenges—including regulatory pressures, public scrutiny over privacy and content moderation, and the intensifying AI arms race—have made it clear that fresh perspectives are needed to navigate this complex landscape. I take pride in our progress toward profitability in Reality Labs and our leadership in open-source AI, but I recognize that my continued tenure may hinder the bold pivots required ahead.  

I am immensely grateful to the Board for their unwavering support, to Sheryl Sandberg and all past and present executives for their partnership, and above all to you, our 70,000+ employees, whose ingenuity made the impossible routine. Javier Olivan will serve as interim CEO while the Board conducts a search for a permanent successor. I remain a significant shareholder and will advise as requested during this transition.  

The mission to "give people the power to build community and bring the world closer together" endures. I have full faith in Meta's ability to thrive.  

Thank you for the journey.  

Sincerely,  

**Mark Zuckerberg**
